name: BitmapPlusPlus
listed_description: Simple and Fast header only Bitmap C++ library
reason: No numbers against any baseline. README (opened in full via grep), repo tree (examples, images, integration_tests, lib) and issues contain no benchmark; 'fast' appears only in the tagline and a 'blazingly-fast' topic tag. Directional claim only.

name: Ion
listed_description: A small and efficient set of libraries for building cross-platform client or server applications that use 3D graphics
reason: Directional claims only ('Small: < 500k binary size on mobile platforms', 'Fast graphics: Minimal overhead between your application and OpenGL / ES') with no timings or comparison against raw OpenGL or DirectX. Repo has base, ion, third_party and util directories, no benchmarks; archived 2023-08-11. Docs site google.github.io/ion is blocked in this environment, so the docs were not read.

name: Irrlicht
listed_description: A high performance realtime 3D engine written in C++
reason: No project-published benchmark found. Project site redirects to irrlicht.sourceforge.io, which is blocked here (EGRESS_BLOCKED). WebSearch snippets showed only user forum posts with anecdotal fps (Irrlicht's own OpenGL versus D3D9 drivers, and informal comparisons with Ogre3D), no methodology; forum pages were not opened. OpenGL and DirectX are the engine's back ends, so they are not a meaningful baseline to beat.

name: libschrift
listed_description: A lightweight TrueType font rendering library
reason: No numeric comparison against any other library. README says only 'In terms of both security and performance, libschrift is already pretty solid'; CHANGELOG has self-relative gains ('15% speed-boost for sft_char' versus an earlier libschrift version) and no baseline; no benchmark directory; WebSearch found no third-party shootout including it (fontdue's published benchmarks do not list it).
